Jukebox-Breakdown.dc.html.title: Jukebox · Song breakdown (opened from the bar)

s1.text:
Jukebox is close to its worked-out feature set: shelves by level, Rock/Pop filter, search, favourites, Surprise me, capo and core shapes, practice pattern, speed, sync nudge.

Open: should a song end with a nudge to try its chords in Bandmaker?

s2.text: Look: dark stage, amber for Jukebox, teal for Bandmaker. Each mode keeps one colour so you always know where you are.

s3.text:
No separate start screen: Home's New song goes straight to step 1, My songs opens the list.

The band selector sits on top of every Bandmaker screen. A new song starts on Rhythm with the guided foundation (feel, key, chords, song). Other members are dimmed until there are chords, then each one follows them, like Bass.

Drums: mostly AI, GarageBand-style. Auto fills, or you choose where fills go. Not designed yet.

s5.text:
Key step teaches and sets the foundation at once:

- what a key is (a home note plus the 7 notes and chords that belong with it)
- major vs minor, linked to the feel you picked
- guitar-friendly keys, ranked by how many easy open shapes they give you
- hear the key before choosing
- a nudge to move it if it's too high or low to sing

s4.text:
Setup is merged into Play along. Tapping a song goes straight to playing.

Under the video, one line says something relevant: "One new shape here: D" or "Three shapes you know". Tapping it opens the song breakdown (diagrams, strum patterns). It never opens by itself.

Try the firstVisit tweak to see the new-shape message.
